id.description: Base ID for the checkbox group. Each checkbox's ID will be this base plus the option's value or index.

tile.description: Render each checkbox as a tile when true

hint.description: Group-level hint text, rendered after the legend

error.description: Group-level error message, rendered after the hint

name.description: Name attribute shared by the checkbox inputs

options.description: Array of option objects: {id, value, label, description, checked, disabled}

className.description: Additional classes to apply to the wrapper
